notes.title: Ring Racer is now released !
notes.notes:
The Sci-fi endless runner from the game jam "Ludum Dare 47" is now released and this is just the beginning.

At the moment you can enjoy a little campaign composed of 3 main galaxies with various obstacles, going faster and faster, choosing from 4 different ships, but there could be even more content in the future. There are plans for additional features but they might be pushed for a Ring Racer 2. If you have feedback or suggestions you are welcome to share them in the discussions forum.
